gates.name: validity_and_leakage
gates.pass_rule: all metrics finite; zero charged message/environment violations; static and runtime taint audit finds zero hidden theta, lambda, regime, latent-state, or oracle-action access in non-oracle policies

gates.name: below_B_N_fallback
gates.interpretation: deterministic policy audit, not empirical proof of information-theoretic impossibility

gates.name: above_B_S_qualification
gates.pass_rule: 100% of learning_aware paths satisfy frozen probe, delay, dual-budget, epsilon_safe, and commit-reserve qualification predicates

gates.name: high_regime_gain
gates.pass_rule: paired mean oracle-regret improvement versus always_all is at least 0.02 relative to mean always_all oracle regret and its simultaneous max-t 95% lower confidence bound is greater than zero in every cell

gates.name: low_regime_safety
gates.pass_rule: one-sided simultaneous 95% upper confidence bound for baseline-relative safety deficit is at most the scenario epsilon_safe in every cell

gates.name: directional_identification
gates.scope: all theorem-scope above_bs cells, low and high evaluated separately
gates.pass_rule: Bonferroni-Holm simultaneous one-sided Clopper-Pearson upper bound for each directional error is at most delta=0.025

gates.name: break_even_bracket
gates.pass_rule: in at least 0.75 of base scenarios, the first registered budget with positive paired mean gain versus always_all lies in the closed [B_N,B_S] bracket; scenarios with no observed positive gain fail this gate

gates.name: novelty_learning_value
gates.scope: prespecified above_bs cells with delay in {4,12} and budget ray in {balanced,message_limited,environment_limited}
gates.pass_rule: learning_aware paired oracle-regret improvement versus information_only is at least 0.03 relative and simultaneous max-t 95% lower confidence bound is greater than zero in every cell; charged violation difference equals zero

gates.name: delay_mechanism
gates.scope: prespecified theorem cells with delay=12 and region=above_bs
gates.pass_rule: no_delay_ablation has either at least 0.02 more wrong-commit probability or strictly higher oracle regret with simultaneous max-t 95% lower bound greater than zero in every cell

gates.name: dual_budget_mechanism
gates.scope: above_bs message_limited and environment_limited theorem cells
gates.pass_rule: each single-budget ablation either has positive intended-budget-violation probability or, after frozen legal projection, has strictly higher oracle regret with simultaneous max-t 95% lower bound greater than zero in every corresponding cell

gates.name: exp015a_freeze
gates.pass_rule: EXP-015A remains 7/8 failure; threshold 0.80 and observed 0.777778 are byte-for-byte unchanged and are not included in EXP-016A gate aggregation

gates.name: reproducibility
gates.scope: clean rerun with identical pilot seeds and committed configuration
gates.pass_rule: core raw CSV, aggregate CSV, gate JSON, metadata JSON, and configuration hash reproduce byte-for-byte

progression: All G1-G12 must pass. There is no aggregate k-of-n override. Any failure stops formal progression.
